interpretation: LoanWorld v0 is a PRE-RESULTS engineering edition: one synthetic gold parent, a tool API and scripted controls. It supports no difficulty, validity, ranking, novelty or real-workflow claim. Forks of one parent are clustered measurements, never independent loans. Handwriting in v0 is a font placeholder and is not valid for any test split.
release_rule: v0 expands only after deterministic solvability, isolated evaluator mutations, branch isolation, result-blind review and one non-ceiling live diagnostic.
